edinburgh_castle_guide.text: Welcome to Edinburgh Castle. Mind the cannon, she is older than your grandparents' grandparents.
In the Crown Room lie the Honours of Scotland, a crown, a sceptre and a sword. They are the oldest crown jewels in the British Isles.
They were locked in a chest in 1707 and forgotten. In 1818 Sir Walter Scott helped lead the search that found them again.
St Margaret's Chapel, up the top, dates from around 1130. It is the oldest building in Edinburgh.

edinburgh_castle_piper.text: Mons Meg, the big old cannon, is from the 1400s and fired stone balls half a metre across. Her barrel burst in 1681, so she retired.
Practising on the Esplanade keeps the wind out of my sporran. I mean the wind in my pipes.
